name: superpowers-project
description: Superpowers extension for durable project setup, GitHub issues and milestones, native user-input grilling, goal-backed execution, and worker-thread orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Project setup, GitHub issues, milestones, goal-backed execution, and orchestration for Superpowers.
interface.longDescription: Superpowers Project extends Superpowers with large-scope project setup, roadmap and milestone mapping, GitHub issue mirrors, issue triage, native request_user_input grilling, native /goal-backed issue resolution, and optional worker-thread orchestration.
defaultPrompt: Use superpowers-project:initiate-workflow to choose the next Superpowers Project route.
Use superpowers-project:setup-project to set up this repo's project context and tracker.
Use superpowers-project:audit-project to turn code and workflow review findings into a repair spec.
Use superpowers-project:align-project to align Superpowers Project workflow drift, tracker state, and live sync.
Use superpowers-project:brainstorm-spec to brainstorm a project idea with native grilling.
Use superpowers-project:create-issues to convert a plan into GitHub issue mirrors.
Use superpowers-project:write-plan to write the project implementation plan.
Use superpowers-project:implement-plan to implement an approved plan on a development branch without creating issue mirrors.
Use superpowers-project:resolve-issue to resolve one GitHub issue directly with a native goal.
Use superpowers-project:orchestrate-issues to delegate issue work to a worker worktree thread.
Use superpowers-project:merge-changes to merge issue-backed PR work or approved local branch work.
